verdict.rationale: Running models larger than VRAM via combined CPU+GPU offload is a fair question for an inference engine, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents CPU weight offloading or a hybrid CPU+GPU split. Quantization (vllm-docs-22) is an adjacent way to shrink memory use, and CPU-only backend support (vllm-docs-11) is a separate capability, so neither earns credit toward offload.
